address: Shri Nakoda Avanti 108 Parshwanath Jain Temple, State Highway 96, Devanahalli, Binnamangala, Karnataka 562110, India

reviews.text:
Nandagokula AC Veg restaurant is a popular vegetarian stop located along State Highway 96 in Devanahalli, situated near the Shri Nakoda Avanti 108 Parshwanath Jain Temple. It is a frequent highway stop for travelers heading toward the airport, Nandi Hills, or Hyderabad on NH 44.
​Cuisine: Pure vegetarian offering South Indian breakfast classics, North Indian curries, Chinese dishes, and chaats.
​Timings: Open daily from 8:00 AM to 10:30 PM.

Disappointing Quality and Highly OverpricedI left this place feeling highly disappointed. The entire experience is unnecessarily overpriced, especially considering the mediocre standards of the self-service area. When you are paying premium prices, you expect a certain level of efficiency, cleanliness, and care. Instead, the self-service section felt entirely basic and offered an overall OKish quality that simply does not justify the final bill.The biggest letdown, however, was the beverage quality. I ordered a standard tea, only to be served a non-fresh tea that had clearly been sitting in a hot container for a long time. It tasted stale and flat, yet they charged ₹30 for it. Charging that much money for pre-made, stagnant tea is unacceptable. It is definitely not worth the quality they are delivering.If a venue expects customers to pay these rates while doing all the ordering and lifting themselves, the food and drink must be exceptional. Sadly, this place misses the mark completely. You can get a much fresher, higher-quality cup of tea at almost any local stall for a fraction of the cost. I highly recommend skipping this spot.
